title: dianthus algetanus subsp. costae
intro: Dianthus algetanus subsp. costae, commonly known as the alpine pink or pink of the Alps, is a flowering plant species belonging to the carnation family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus algetanus subsp. costae include its ability to calm and soothe, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
